pages.aboutSubtitle: A Travel Community for Travellers, By Travellers
pages.aboutIntroFirst: Explore treks, beaches and cultural getaways with Team Weekend Trekkers. Meet fellow travellers and discover new places on a weekend away from Bengaluru.
pages.aboutIntroSecond: Join a community of {travellers} happy travellers. Choose your next trip, review the itinerary and inclusions, and reach our team whenever you need help.
pages.aboutValue1Title: We Go Where Google Maps Doesn't
pages.aboutValue1Text: Forget overcrowded tourist spots. We take you to hidden waterfalls, secret viewpoints, and offbeat trails that even locals don't know about. Every trip is a discovery.
pages.aboutValue2Text: From Bangalore pickup to the summit and back — transport, stays, permits, meals, guides — we handle it all. No hidden costs, no last-minute surprises. Just pure adventure.
pages.aboutValue3Text: We keep groups small intentionally. Music playlists, bonfire conversations, and shared sunrises create friendships that last beyond the trip. It's not a tour — it's an experience.
pages.aboutStory1: It all started with a simple weekend trek to the Western Ghats. A group of friends, tired of the Monday-to-Friday grind, decided to explore the mountains instead of binge-watching another series. That first trek changed everything.
pages.aboutStory2: We realized there were thousands like us — people craving adventure but not knowing where to start. So we decided to become that starting point. Today, every weekend, we help people swap their screens for sunrises, their AC rooms for mountain air, and their weekend plans for lifelong memories.

pages.contactFaq1Title: How do I book a trip?
pages.contactFaq1Text: Choose your trip, departure date and travellers. Pay using the QR code or UPI ID shown at checkout, then submit your transaction ID. Our team verifies payment and availability before confirming your booking. Some trips also offer a booking request option.
pages.contactFaq2Title: What's included in the trip cost?
pages.contactFaq2Text: Check your chosen trip's inclusions and exclusions for transport, stays, meals, permits and other details.
pages.contactFaq3Title: Can I join as a solo traveller?
pages.contactFaq3Text: Yes. You can join a group departure and meet fellow travellers. Contact our team if you have questions before booking.
pages.contactFaq4Text: Read the cancellation policy on your chosen trip page before booking. Contact our team if you need help changing or cancelling a booking.

items.name: Mohanraj suvarna
items.text: We had a truly memorable experience exploring Kochi, Alleppey, and Varkala. The trip was peaceful, well-organized, and all the places were covered comfortably on time. Our trip captain was very friendly, cool, and managed everything really well throughout the journey. Special thanks to Madrasir Ji for driving us safely. Overall, we absolutely loved the places and had a wonderful experience! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

items.name: Pavan Shinde
items.text: This was my first trip in Bangalore with an unknown group of people, but by the end of it, I genuinely felt like I'd made some amazing friends. Wonderful experience!

items.name: S N
items.text: The guide Mr. Richee is a very humble guy. Who took care of each individual traveller. Patiently waiting for everyone to arrive and made sure no one was left out. Creates a comfort zone!

items.name: Harjinder Bhatti
items.text: I went on a trip to Rameshwaram, Dhanushkodi, navagraha temples and Thanjavur Temple. My first solo trip and I quickly found comfort in the amazing people I met. 😃

items.name: Sandeep Reddy
items.text: Amazing experience on Rameshwaram-Dhanushkodi trip! Our tour guide Vinayaka S was so kind and patient with all of us. Though we part ways, the memories we've made will always keep us connected.

items.name: Uma Bhat
items.text: Me and my friend booked for Rameshwaram and Tanjavur weekend package. Met many new people and spending these 2 days as a group was fun. Highly recommended!
